title: Lab - Deploying a CNI
description: Install a network plugin on a cluster that has none.
scenario: Install a network plugin on a cluster that has none. This lab is a skeleton: the tasks name what to do and how to check it; work them on your own cluster and expand your notes as you go.
environment_setup:
# A three-node kind cluster is enough for this lab
cat <<'EOF' > kind-cka.yaml
kind: Cluster
apiVersion: kind.x-k8s.io/v1alpha4
name: cka
nodes:
  - role: control-plane
  - role: worker
  - role: worker
EOF
kind create cluster --config kind-cka.yaml
kubectl get nodes
cleanup:
kind delete cluster --name cka
rm -f kind-cka.yaml

tasks.title: Task 1 - Symptom
tasks.instructions: The cluster nodes are NotReady and Pods are stuck ContainerCreating. Why?
tasks.solution: kubectl describe node node01 | grep -i network

tasks.title: Task 2 - Install
tasks.instructions: Install the Flannel (or Calico) manifest and set its Pod CIDR to match the cluster.
tasks.solution: kubectl apply -f kube-flannel.yml  # edit net-conf.json Network to the cluster podCIDR

tasks.title: Task 3 - Verify
tasks.instructions: Which IP range do new Pods now get?
tasks.solution: kubectl run t --image=nginx; kubectl get pod t -o wide
